requiresAuth.title: {{feature}} requires authentication mode
requiresAuth.body: {{feature}} is only available when TeslaSync is configured behind an authentication provider (Authentik, Authelia, oauth2-proxy, Keycloak, or similar). Set FORWARD_AUTH_HEADER on the API service to enable it.
requiresAuth.bodyWithHint: {{feature}} is only available when TeslaSync is configured behind an authentication provider ({{provider}}). Set FORWARD_AUTH_HEADER on the API service to enable it.
